documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Digikore Studios Limited reported a strong H1 FY26 performance with total revenue growing 59.6% year-on-year to INR36.13 crores and PAT increasing by 117% to INR6.11 crores, driven by pent-up demand and a higher mix of episodic and direct work. Management highlighted expanding global client approvals and aggressive sales pushes across Europe and North America, alongside strategic fundraising initiatives including a INR45 crores QIP and promoter warrants of INR20 crores. The company is actively investing in future-proofing technologies such as AI-assisted workflows, virtual production assets, and branded content verticals while maintaining a disciplined approach to capital allocation and debt reduction. Digikore Studios reported strong H1 FY26 financial results with total income increasing to ₹36.13 Cr and net profit rising to ₹6.11 Cr. Management highlighted robust industry tailwinds, including post-strike recovery and a catch-up wave of VFX-heavy content from major Hollywood studios.

guidance.claim: Management stated a goal to reach 80% direct work by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: And our goal over the next year, that is by the end of FY ‘27, is to be at 80% direct work and we are moving in that direction pretty well.

guidance.claim: The company is committed to sustaining a 30% plus CAGR over the next few years.
guidance.quote: We are committed to sustaining 30% plus CAGR over the next few years, supported by industry tailwinds, our sales engine, technology leverage and a sharper client mix.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates VFX margins will settle in the 16% to 18% range.
guidance.quote: Going forward, I anticipate VFX will settle in the same range of 16% to 18%.

guidance.claim: Management guided for a CAGR of over 30% across the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Independent trackers point to animation and VFX growing at a 12.12% CAGR through 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: For example, one recent market view animation and VFX at a 12.12% CAGR through 2030, underpinned by streamer demand, real-time pipelines, and cloud rendering.

demand_outlook.claim: Virtual production is projected to compound at between 18% and 33% CAGR by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: Within this, virtual production is expanding even faster with estimates ranging from 18% to 33% CAGR for virtual production by 2030, reflecting the shift to LED volumes and on-set visualization in real-world shoots.

demand_outlook.claim: Episodic content accounts for 80% of company revenue, providing pipeline visibility and consistent cash conversion.
demand_outlook.quote: Today, 80% of our revenue is episodic, which provides pipeline visibility, seasonality balance, and more consistent cash conversion relative to one-off terms.

demand_outlook.claim: The global VFX industry is estimated to be around $9.5 billion.
demand_outlook.quote: See, the international, the global VFX industry is estimated to be around $9.5 billion, okay?

demand_outlook.claim: Hollywood productions are increasingly VFX-heavy, with major studios allocating up to 40% of total budgets to visual effects in tentpole films and episodic.
demand_outlook.quote: Hollywood productions are increasingly VFX-heavy, with major studios allocating up to 40% of total budgets to visual effects in tentpole films and episodic.

demand_outlook.claim: The rise of streaming giants like Netflix, Amazon, and Disney+ has led to an explosion in episodic content requiring high-end VFX.
demand_outlook.quote: The rise of streaming giants like Netflix, Amazon, and Disney+ has led to an explosion in episodic content requiring high-end VFX.

demand_outlook.claim: Shorter production timelines and global competition have increased demand for reliable, scalable VFX outsourcing partners.
demand_outlook.quote: Shorter production timelines and global competition have increased demand for reliable, scalable VFX outsourcing partners.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Hollywood production has fully resumed and projects have restarted.
demand_outlook.quote: Hollywood production fully resumed; projects restarted.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted a massive demand pipeline with the VFX industry returning strongly.
demand_outlook.quote: VFX Industry is back with a Bang - massive demand pipeline

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported meeting 44 studios in a Europe and US sales drive with vendor onboarding in progress.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe and US sales drive: 44 studios met, vendor onboarding in progress.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved establishing a subsidiary in New York to anchor North America growth.
capex_expansion.quote: We have just got approval from our board, and we are working towards establishing a subsidiary in New York, basically to anchor North America growth and response time.

capex_expansion.claim: Virtual production asset library items are monetizing on Unreal Engine's fab.com.
capex_expansion.quote: More importantly, our VP asset library is already monetizing on Unreal Engine's fab.com, and we are seeing growing revenues from fab.com month-on-month, which is a great sign.

margins_costs.claim: Operating expenses as a percentage of revenue fell to 78.6% from 83% in H1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: operating expenses as a percentage of revenue fell to 78.6% from 83%, an improvement of 440 bps on a mix, utilization and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: International streaming platforms and production companies are currently averse to using AI in content production.
margins_costs.quote: As of today, international streaming platforms, international production companies like Netflix, Amazon, Disney, Warner, Marvel, they are yet averse to using AI in content production.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that leveraging AI helps boost internal VFX productivity, reduce turnaround times, and enhance margins and scalability.
margins_costs.quote: We are actively leveraging AI to boost internal VFX productivity and reduce turnaround times — enhancing margins and scalability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is sitting on an order book of over INR20 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: We are today sitting in an order book of over INR20 crores, and we'll definitely keep this momentum, more meetings, more demos, more wins, because it's a no-brainer.

orders_capacity.claim: Direct work share has increased, with the company achieving almost a 50:50 ratio of direct work.
orders_capacity.quote: This year, we have achieved almost 50:50 ratio, which is 50% direct work compared to last year, which was only 20% direct work.

orders_capacity.claim: The current bidding pipeline holds over INR35 crores worth of projects.
orders_capacity.quote: So, currently, we have almost -- I don't have the exact figure, but if you're asking bidding, what is in bidding, we have over INR35 crores worth of projects in bidding.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported a current order book of approximately ₹25 crores from the US and Europe.
orders_capacity.quote: Order book ~ ₹25 Cr from US & Europe.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is completing a INR45 crore QIP fundraise in November.
capital_allocation.quote: On capital and balance sheet, again a very important part of any business, we will be completing our INR45 crore QIP fundraise in November.

capital_allocation.claim: Following the QIP, promoters intend to infuse INR20 crore via convertible warrants.
capital_allocation.quote: Following the QIP, the promoters also intend to infuse INR20 crore via convertible warrants.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Hollywood writers and actors strike created an unprecedented pause for the content industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Hollywood writers and actors strike created an unprecedented pause.

risks_headwinds.claim: Major US studios avoid generative AI in production due to extreme conservatism regarding copyright claims.
risks_headwinds.quote: And I was also recently, like, on one of my calls, I said I was with the head of VFX at Amazon. I was having lunch with him. And they are not yet ready to use AI in their production pipeline, the actual, what we call a generative AI, that is creating images or creating videos using AI, because they are extremely scared, extremely conservative of copyright.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trump tariffs cannot be applied to services according to management commentary.
risks_headwinds.quote: Trump tariffs cannot be applied to services, firstly. There is no way you can tariff services.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that FY2024-25 was impacted by Hollywood writers' and actors' strikes.
risks_headwinds.quote: FY2024–25 impacted by Hollywood writers’ & actors’ strikes

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that revenue dipped from ₹49.47 Cr in FY23-24 to ₹37 Cr in FY24-25.
risks_headwinds.quote: Revenue dipped from ₹49.47 Cr (FY23–24) to ₹37 Cr (FY24–25)

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach an 80% direct work ratio by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And our goal over the next year, that is by the end of FY ‘27, is to be at 80% direct work and we are moving in that direction pretty well.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets sustaining a 30% plus CAGR over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: We are committed to sustaining 30% plus CAGR over the next few years, supported by industry tailwinds, our sales engine, technology leverage and a sharper client mix.

management_commitments.claim: Management targeted onboarding 8 to 10 more new clients by December 2025.
management_commitments.quote: Target to onboard 8 to 10 more new clients by December 2025.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
